Let’s build incredible things together.

We’re solving difficult problems in an open, helpful, and supportive environment – and we’re having fun while doing it. Ready for your next career move? Find an open position and apply.

Why Justt?

Deliver impact at startup speed

At Justt, you’ll make a meaningful impact from day one. Every role is critical, and we move quickly—just like a startup.

Solve big problems with the most advanced tech

We’re tackling some of the most challenging problems in AI. If you’re passionate about working with cutting-edge technology, you’ll thrive here.

Work with the greatest group of people

Our team is our greatest asset. We hire for cultural fit as much as skill, and we strive to create a supportive, inclusive environment where you can be your true self.

What our team loves about Justt

It is a great place to work. My ideas are heard, I feel valued, and I am excited to come to work every day. A great work-life balance too.

Daniel Zacks

Revenue Operations Architect

At Justt, we foster a collaborative and open environment where the team works closely together in an open-space office. We value consulting with each other and sharing ideas, ensuring everyone has a voice in shaping our work. The office is located in the heart of Tel Aviv, so after-hours, we often unwind at nearby bars, enjoying the city’s vibrant atmosphere. While our workplace is mature and professional, we know how to have fun when the time is right, maintaining a balanced and relaxed vibe when it’s needed, without always taking things too seriously.

Ido Bar Borer

Full Stack Developer
